correctness.rationale: Exactly 18 Euclidean type-B3 roots, short ±e_i, long ±e_i±e_j without shell normalization, inclusive diameter thresholds. Direct squared-coordinate differences have levels 1,2,3,4,5,6,8, so no other stages. At q=1 the once-subdivided octahedron graph has cycle rank 7. At q=2 the subdivided cuboctahedral boundary B is a 32-triangle S2 with 12 short-short bridge triangles collapsible to B and 8 remaining octahedron-facet cells attached along null loops; thus wedge9 S2. Independently regenerated all 426 q=3 faces and reproduced the 164 stepwise unique-coface free-face pairs in the actual Git certificate, leaving precisely the 98 faces of B, so inclusion of B induces a primitive persistent Z summand while the other eight die. Independently reconstructed full q=4,5,6 flag complexes with 715,5567,46655 faces, produced 357,2783,23327 vertex-toggle pairs, and topologically sorted every oriented Hasse incidence (2484,29742,326574) with only one critical vertex; hence contractible. q=8 full simplex; inclusivity and split-surjective H2 map yield exact integral barcodes.
